verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents automatic collection of compliance data from connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP. That data automatically satisfies evidence requests and powers continuous monitors, with integrations refreshing data up to daily. This covers machine-gathered, scheduled collection, but the sources are mostly marketing and help-center claims. Missing for 10: documentation that collected artifacts are timestamped, explicit replacement of screenshot and CSV evidence, configurable collection schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
